topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I poured my heart and soul into this invention. Countless nights, endless revisions, it’s like my baby. And now, I’ve just found out it’s already patented. By someone else. All this time, I could have done something else, pursued another passion. But no, I went all in on this. I checked and rechecked my research, hoping against hope there was some mistake, some loophole, anything. But there’s nothing. What am I supposed to do now? I can’t just give up, but I don’t know how to move forward. Everything I believed in seems to have crumbled overnight.
